lines.1: 「This week is Education-Intensification Week, so we will have classes on Saturday as well. Please take care not to forget.」
lines.2: What a pain in the ass.
lines.3: Sighs escaped all around the classroom.
lines.4: 「Now, now. An occasional event like this is not so bad, is it?」
lines.5: ...Miss Inori, the one saying that, looked more listless than anyone.
lines.6: 「Let us all enjoy another delightful week of school.」
lines.8: Our class goal for the week was, 'Let's enjoy every day.'
lines.9: It was exactly the kind of goal our class would choose.
